headline: Media library, one identity per title, and public API v2
upgradeWarning: Back up before upgrading. The database migrates heavily; a 1.5 backup restores cleanly on 2.0

highlights.title: Media section
highlights.body: Browse the whole library as a poster wall with an A to Z rail and filters for library, resolution, HDR, size on disk, and watched. Detail pages list every copy of a title with per-file quality, library, and size, with genre, storage, and watch pages alongside.

highlights.title: One identity per title
highlights.body: The same movie on two servers is one row everywhere: stats, leaderboards, and history. Seasons and music get identities too, and wrongly split titles heal themselves.

highlights.title: Every file counted
highlights.body: Every version of a title is tracked: 4K and 1080p copies, duplicate libraries, mirrored files counted once. Storage totals add up, duplicates catches same-server copies, sessions record which version played, and 1440p and 8K no longer count as SD.

highlights.title: Public API v2
highlights.body: Bearer tokens, rate limits, and OpenAPI docs served in the app, built so tools that use Tautulli can use Tracearr instead.

changes.text: Plex library changes sync in seconds through server events
the mobile app picks All, one server, or any subset from any tab, and it sticks across restarts
mobile navigation uses native tabs that stay put on detail screens, and a server sheet replaces the drawer
mobile controls work with screen readers
upgrades show migration progress, and a bad migration can't boot-loop the server
closed a silent gap in sharing detection on polled servers
stale content and ROI stop double counting merged titles
servers reached over Tailscale connect again on iOS
the mobile stream map follows the dark theme on both platforms
counts may shift after upgrade as versions and identities settle
overall trust scores show a person's worst account, and violation totals count again
